sample.question:
A load is energized only when every switch on its path from GEN is closed. After each toggle, sum energized demand. If it exceeds generator capacity, the protection relay trips and all loads become de-energized for the rest of that sequence.
Close currently open switch K1. What happens immediately?
A. Relay trips; no loads remain energized
B. Stable; energized loads=none
C. Stable; energized loads=L3
D. Only the newly connected load trips
E. Stable; energized loads=L1,L3
sample.analysis: With K1 closed, path evaluation gives pre-trip demand 4 against capacity 4. Therefore: Stable; energized loads=L1,L3. The answer is E.
options: A. Relay trips; no loads remain energized
D. Only the newly connected load trips
